description.value: Country Vines Winery is a family-owned, small-batch estate winery on Steveston Highway in Richmond, producing award-winning wines from grapes grown in its on-site vineyard — an unexpected terroir for the Lower Mainland. Visitors can join guided vineyard and barrel room tours, enjoy charcuterie pairings in a covered outdoor lounge, or relax in the picnic area alongside resident animals. The winery hosts live music throughout the summer season and is proudly pet- and family-friendly.

Wine is sold in-store and charcuterie is served on-site, but no packaged takeout food offering is described.
